To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
2r, 6c-diaryldiethylaminopiperidin- 4-one derivatives 1–8 are synthesized by the reaction of diethylamine with different substituted aromatic aldehydes in the presence of acetic acid.
the synthesized 2r, 6c-diarypiperidines 1–8 and their derivatives 10–17 have been characterized by IR, 13C, 1H and 2D 1H,13C NMR spectral studies.

the synthesized compounds showed significant antibacterial and antifungal activity against the tested microorganisms and that the 2r,5c-dichloro substituted derivatives were found to have better antibacterial and antitubercular activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of new series of substituted 2r, 6c-diarypiperidin- 4-one and 2-(benzo-thiazol-2-y1)-1-(alkvl-2r, 5c-diarylpipcrldin-4- ylidine)hydrazinc derivatives.
the synthesis, characterization and antimicrobial screening of new derivatives of 1,2,6,7-tetrahydropyrano[4,3-c]pyridines.
the design, synthesis, characterization and biological evaluation of new 2-(benzo-thiazol-2yl)-1-(4-substituted piperidin-2,6-dialkyl)hydrazinylidene)benzothiazoles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of electron-withdrawing group in the benzothiazole ring is responsible for the increase in the activity.

the presence of a piperidine ring at position 4 of 4-oxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine moiety in the structure of the compounds 10–17, as well as the presence of the 2-(benzo-thiazol-2yl) group in the hydrazine moiety, are responsible for their high antimicrobial activity.
the synthesized compounds 10–17 showed significant activity against all the tested micro-organisms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antimicrobial activity of the compounds was dependent on the type and number of substituents on the aromatic rings and the piperidinone ring.

the presence of the 2-(benzo-thiazol-2yl)hydrazinyl substituent at the C-4 position of the piperidinyl ring is responsible for the antimicrobial activity, and the nature of the 2r, 6c substituents on the piperidyl ring is also important in determining the magnitude of activity.
the antimicrobial activity of the compounds 10–17 is mainly governed by the substituent on the benzene ring of the 2,6-diaryl substituent of the piperidin-1,4-diones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2,6-disubstituted 4-oxo-4-phenylpiperidine derivatives 10 and 12–17 are potent antimicrobial agents.
the presence of a 4-oxo group in the piperidine ring is essential for the activity.
all the compounds were found to be active against all the tested microorganisms and some of the synthesized compounds were found to have significant antimicrobial activity.
